title: Settings
description: Your details, sign-in security and personal data in one place.

profile.detailsDescription: Colleagues in your organizations see this name, and it appears on reports you create.
profile.name: Full name
profile.emailHint: You sign in with this email. To change it, contact the system administrator.
profile.languageDescription: Menus, buttons and messages appear in this language. It is also saved to your account.
profile.planDescription: Covers the profiles you keep for yourself and your family. Organizations have their own plans.
profile.upgradeHint: Need more profiles? Contact us to upgrade your plan.
profile.orgsDescription: Clinics and other medical organizations you belong to.
profile.orgsEmpty: You don't belong to an organization yet.
profile.orgsEmptyHint: Join with an invitation from your clinic, or register your own organization.

password.title: Password
password.signOutNotice: After the change you will be signed out on every device, including this one. Then sign in with your new password.
password.newHint: At least {min} characters. A short phrase is easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.tooLong: This password is too long. Please choose a shorter one.
password.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
password.changed: Password changed. Please sign in again.

twoStep.title: 2-step sign-in
twoStep.description: Besides your password, sign-in asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS or Authy).
twoStep.requiredBody: Platform staff and members of medical organizations must keep 2-step sign-in on, because they can reach health records.
twoStep.lowCodesTitle: {count, plural, one {Only # recovery code left} other {Only # recovery codes left}}
twoStep.lowCodesBody: Create new codes now, so you can still sign in if you lose your phone.
twoStep.recoveryExplain: A recovery code lets you sign in when your phone is not at hand. Each code works once.
twoStep.cannotTurnOff: 2-step sign-in can't be turned off for platform staff and organization members.
twoStep.offBody: Your account is protected by your password only. Turn on 2-step sign-in so that a stolen password is not enough to open it.

recovery.confirmDescription: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Confirm with your password and a code from your authenticator app.
recovery.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your unused recovery codes.
recovery.codeInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code, or a recovery code such as K7QM-2XPR-9TBW.
recovery.codesDescription: If your phone is not at hand, use one of these codes instead of the 6-digit code. Each code works once.
recovery.shownOnceBody: Save the codes now: download or print them, or keep them in a password manager. Store them away from your phone.
recovery.printBlocked: The print window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site, or download the codes instead.
recovery.savedConfirm: I have saved these codes in a safe place.

file.title: Bio-Dosha-12 recovery codes
file.note: Each code works once. Earlier codes no longer work. Keep this sheet in a safe place, away from your phone.

disableTwoStep.title: Turn off 2-step sign-in?
disableTwoStep.description: Your account will then be protected by your password only. You can turn it on again at any time.
disableTwoStep.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
disableTwoStep.codeInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code, or a recovery code such as K7QM-2XPR-9TBW.
disableTwoStep.requiredForRole: Your role requires 2-step sign-in, so it can't be turned off.

signOutAll.title: Sign out on all devices
signOutAll.description: Use this if you signed in on a shared or lost device. Every session ends, including this one.
signOutAll.confirmDescription: You will be signed out on every phone and computer, including this one. You can sign in again right away.

privacy.exportDescription: A copy of what Bio-Dosha-12 keeps about you personally.
privacy.exportIncludes2: Your own and your family's profiles
privacy.exportExcludes: Not included: a clinic's patient records. They belong to the organization.
privacy.exportFormat: A JSON file that most programs can open.
privacy.noticeBody: Read the <link>Privacy Notice</link> to see what we store, why, and who can see it.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your account. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.deletes1: Your account and sign-in are deleted.
deleteAccount.deletes2: Your own and your family's profiles are deleted with all their calculations.
deleteAccount.keeps: Patient records you entered for an organization stay with that organization.
deleteAccount.blockedBody: You are the only owner of an organization that still has other members. Make one of them an owner before you delete your account:
deleteAccount.blockedSeveral: If you belong to several organizations, choose each one at the top of the organization page.
deleteAccount.blockedHint: You can delete your account once every organization above has another owner.
deleteAccount.soleTitle: These organizations will be deleted too
deleteAccount.soleBody: You are the only member of these organizations, so they and all their patient records will be deleted with your account:
deleteAccount.patients: {count, plural, one {{formatted} patient record} other {{formatted} patient records}}
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Your account, profiles and calculations will be deleted and cannot be restored.
deleteAccount.alsoOrganizations: Also delete these organizations and their patient records:
deleteAccount.organizationsRequired: Please confirm that the organizations listed are deleted too.
deleteAccount.superadminTitle: The platform owner account can't be deleted here
deleteAccount.superadminBody: This account owns the platform. Deleting it from the settings is blocked, so the platform is never left without an owner.
